verdict.rationale: Bevy is fully open-source under MIT/Apache 2.0 with source hosted on GitHub, explicitly framed as giving developers ownership and visibility into the engine, and community feedback confirms the license and codebase quality ("MIT License... no strings attached", "had a look... at the code and it looks incredibly elegant"). This directly satisfies reading and modifying full engine source when hitting a wall. Missing for 10: no explicit case study of a developer patching core engine source to unblock themselves.
